title: Admiral Ackbar
description: A leader of the Rebel Alliance, Admiral Ackbar was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. He helped Mon Mothma present the briefing on the plan to attack the second Death Star. When the attack came, Ackbar commanded the Rebel fleet. Ackbar coordinated the attack on the Empire's capital ships, while Lando Calrissian led the run inside the superstructure of the Death Star. The Rebels emerged victorious.
